{{Quote|He is a bounty hunter called ''Dust''. He is very good at what he does, so if you want to collect on this job, you had better get moving.|Raze|<ref name="royal ransom" />}}
'''Dust''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], he was contracted by [[Raze (criminal)|Raze]] to find the kidnapped daughter of [[Orocco]]'s [[King/Legends|King]], [[Arturo]]. Unaware of the fact that [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Mi]] was in friendly hand of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], he followed the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to [[Cataalda]] where he captured both ladies while Han and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were busy fighting [[K1l-R]]. However, by the time he recognized Leia as the princess of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Solo and Chewie arrived to rescue them. K1l-R destroyed Dust's [[Conqueror-class assault ship|''Conqueror''-class assault ship]], but the Dust found himself attacked by K1l-R as well. Dust's full body [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was damaged in the [[Fire/Legends|explosion]], which revealed his original blue skin. By the time he destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], Solo already returned Princess Mi to her father, so Dust could no longer pursue his [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]].
